channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center and Roadmap Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages and Microsoft 365 Roadmap posts from message.cengizyilmaz.net. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1465780: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels starting mid-November 2026. This enhances consistent data protection, reduces manual labeling, and supports compliance without requiring admin action. Organizations should review label policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint's new Copilot skill "Create interactive slide" enables users on Windows, Mac, and web to easily create interactive, full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, and data. Attendees can interact independently in PowerPoint Live for Teams. Rollout begins mid-October 2026; a Copilot license is required.

item.title: RM489825: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Overview of recent comments and changes in Word
item.description: Use Copilot to see a summary of the latest comments and changes made to your Word files using the Copilot chat pane.

item.title: RM492622: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: We're now introducing the third generation of the Microsoft 365 sharing experience designed to make collaboration simpler, smarter, and more secure by default. At the heart of this update is the new hero link, a single, powerful link that controls access to your files. Whether you copy a link, share via email, or send the URL from your browser, you now have a seamless and consistent way to share and stay in control of your files.

item.title: RM502541: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s)
item.description: Improved discovery of Copilot connector sources in Microsoft 365 Copilot (optionally add chat) with Content Source filter(s).

item.title: RM515145: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Workforce Insights Agent
item.description: Workforce Insights (WFI) Agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot is an agent designed to help leaders, managers, and their delegates quickly understand their organization by turning complex workforce data into clear, actionable insights. With WFI Agent, leaders can quickly explore their organization’s structure, team composition, skills inventories, and flexible work patterns to move from insight to action in a single, unified experience directly in Copilot or Teams.

item.title: RM537284: Microsoft Edge: Adding contextual nudges to the Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat icon
item.description: Edge for Business will soon help users quickly take contextual action on their open pages using contextual nudges attached to the Copilot icon in the toolbar

item.title: RM560338: Excel: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel
item.description: Plan Mode for Copilot in Excel helps users make complex changes with confidence by outlining a clear, step by step approach before anything in the workbook is updated. Users can review how Copilot intends to complete the task, see which data or capabilities may be used, and adjust the plan as needed—ensuring edits are intentional, transparent, and aligned with their goals before they’re applied. This makes it easier to tackle multi step or high impact tasks while staying in control of every chan...

item.title: RM566321: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Export DLP and Label Policy Configurations
item.description: A new export functionality will be introduced in two locations: the Data Loss Prevention > Policies page and the Information Protection > Label publishing policies page. This feature will allow users to export their existing DLP configurations and label policies, including schema, as a downloadable ZIP file. The exported file can be attached to support tickets to accelerate troubleshooting.

item.title: RM566699: Microsoft Viva: Discussion Post Previews
item.description: Discussion post previews allow users to review how their discussion posts will appear before publishing, helping them catch formatting issues, validate content, and post with greater confidence.

item.title: RM568074: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
item.description: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

item.title: RM568217: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
item.description: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

item.title: RM568786: Microsoft Edge: Inline Switching for Workspaces
item.description: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

item.title: RM568793: Microsoft Edge: Updated horizontal tab appearance
item.description: Microsoft Edge is introducing an updated horizontal tab-strip appearance on Windows and macOS. The treatment uses rounded tabs with revised spacing and aligns related tab-strip controls with the refreshed browser-frame design. Tab behavior and enterprise data handling remain unchanged. Note: We have made the decision to cancel this planned release. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

item.title: RM570847: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
item.description: Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.

item.title: RM573157: Microsoft Teams: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings
item.description: Impersonation Protection for Teams meetings helps users identify potentially deceptive participants and meeting organizers. When Teams detects a potential impersonation attempt, it surfaces warnings and risk indicators to help users recognize suspicious identities and make more informed decisions when joining or participating in a meeting.

item.title: RM573451: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing...

item.title: MC1490912: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android starting November 2026. Users can rate audio, video, and screen-sharing quality after meetings. Feedback helps improve Teams services. No admin action is required before rollout; updating the app and informing users is recommended.

item.title: MC1490911: Microsoft Edge: Retiring legacy sign-in implementation on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Edge on Windows will retire its legacy direct-WAM sign-in in version 157, fully adopting the OneAuth library to standardize authentication. Rollout starts and completes in November 2026. Admins should identify unmigrated profiles, test transitions, and prepare for possible user sign-in prompts.

item.title: MC1490909: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management: Private preview for selected developer package vulnerability coverage
item.description: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management is privately previewing expanded vulnerability coverage for selected Node.js, Python, and Java packages on Windows devices. It integrates with existing workflows, APIs, and exports, with rollout planned from September to December 2026. Organizations should prepare for increased data volume and validate integrations before enabling.

item.title: MC1490906: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization in Teams Pro Management portal
item.description: Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal will add desk utilization analytics, showing usage, reservations, occupancy, and peak patterns. Requires desks with peripheral devices and appropriate Shared Space licenses. Rolling out worldwide from November to mid-December 2026 to aid space planning without compliance concerns.

item.title: MC1490905: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Post-delivery protection for malicious QR codes in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 extends Teams URL protection to detect malicious URLs in QR codes post-delivery, warning users and enabling security teams to investigate via Advanced Hunting. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, no user action is required, but admins should review related settings and processes.

item.title: MC1490903: 'Record A Skill' Capability in PowerPoint Copilot
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot will introduce a "Record a Skill" feature in October 2026, allowing users to record and reuse workflows for common tasks. This enhances efficiency and consistency without requiring admin action. Organizations should inform support teams and users about this new capability.

item.title: MC1490899: Microsoft 365: Targeted Release retirement
item.description: Microsoft 365 Targeted Release will retire in January 2027, replaced by Frontier, Standard, and Deferred release options. Administrators must update user enrollments and release preferences by November 2026, when Targeted Release management ends and a unified release preferences experience launches in the admin center.

item.title: MC1454378: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing, with no required user action before rollout.

item.title: MC1437671: Microsoft Entra: Authenticated password change in My Sign-Ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra will enable authenticated password changes in My Sign-Ins starting mid-October 2026. Users with strong credentials (passkey, FIDO2 key, Windows Hello) can reset passwords without knowing the current one or using SSPR. The feature is off by default and requires admin activation tenant-wide.

item.title: MC1438571: Default visibility of additional profile card properties in Microsoft 365 profile cards
item.description: Microsoft planned to make 11 profile card properties visible by default in Microsoft 365 but decided not to proceed with this change as of October 7, 2026. Administrators can manage visibility using Microsoft Graph APIs, with no automatic rollout occurring at this time.

item.title: MC1388706: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
item.description: Copilot for Legal is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding beyond the U.S. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate tracked changes. No separate installation is needed; access requires Frontier enrollment and Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1227622: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026, consolidating management of all Teams devices into one portal. Deprecation of device management in TAC will begin October 2026, with phased rollouts and migration guidance provided.

item.title: MC1479509: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: Starting mid-October to mid-December 2026, new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will roll out an automatic spell check before sending emails. Users can enable this feature if Connected Experiences are on. Organizations should review privacy policies and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1489971: Microsoft Purview DLP: Improved setup and Intune multi-admin approval support for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Purview DLP will improve setup and support Intune multi-admin approval for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business, offering clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune admins without changing existing policies or enforcement.

item.title: MC1479516: Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
item.description: The Link Preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired due to the deprecation of the browser service needed for previews. Links remain clickable, no action is required, but users should be informed that preview cards will no longer appear.

item.title: RM160010: Microsoft Purview compliance portal: Optical character recognition (OCR) support for SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
item.description: Optical character recognition (OCR) support will detect sensitive content in images and subsequently apply data loss prevention (DLP) policies to prevent exfiltration of that sensitive data in SharePoint Online and OneDrive. This release supports key file types like JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, and PDF (image-only PDF).

item.title: RM508524: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.

item.title: RM545896: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
item.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning iss...

item.title: RM558689: Outlook: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Tips & Override in Outlook for Mac
item.description: Outlook for Mac now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks. When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules.

item.title: RM560539: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Dataverse data connected to Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Let people search and query Dataverse business data from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

item.title: RM561320: Microsoft Purview: Use sensitivity labels to block all connected experiences that analyze content in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
item.description: In Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, the ‘Prevent some connected experiences that analyze content’ label setting now prevents files in these apps from being sent to all Microsoft connected experiences for analysis, rather than a subset of these connected experiences.

item.title: RM562352: Microsoft 365: Pay-as-you-go storage for OneDrive
item.description: New pay-as-you-go, consumption-based meter for additional OneDrive storage. Control which OneDrive accounts can grow beyond their licensed storage limits and give selected users more space as needed.

item.title: RM563807: Outlook: Choose to Show Unread or Total Count for Each Folder
item.description: You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count. Until now, Outlook only displayed unread counts, but sometimes you need to see how many items are in a folder overall. Just right-click any folder and choose whether to show the total or unread count. It gives you more control over how you keep track of your email without changing how anything else works. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM564613: Microsoft Teams: New layout when sharing content for Teams events
item.description: Organizers and presenters who have access to production tools will see updated layout options when sharing content in the "Manage what attendees see" experience for Teams events. The available layouts are "Speaker focused", "Content focused", and "Content only". The new Speaker focused layout prioritizes presenter video alongside shared content for greater visibility. This feature is available for Teams events organizers with a Teams Enterprise license. This feature is available on Teams for Win...

item.title: RM564619: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Enhanced user profile in IRM alerts
item.description: We’re enhancing the User section within Insider Risk Management alerts to provide investigators with more contextual user profile and risk attributes directly within their workflow. With this update, analysts can now view key user details such as employee type, office location, start date, policy inclusion, priority user group status, and last working day—helping them build a more complete understanding of the user during investigations without navigating away from the alert experience. This fea...

item.title: RM564620: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts & cases
item.description: We’re introducing a new collaboration capability in Insider Risk Management that enables analysts and investigators to add notes directly within alerts. With this feature, users can document investigation progress, share findings, and capture key context throughout the triage process. In addition to manually added notes, system‑generated notes will automatically record updates such as alert status changes or user assignments — helping teams maintain a clear and auditable investigation timeline....

item.title: RM565132: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls
item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute. You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the channel. This added flexibility enables you to set notifications to match to your work style and reduce unnecessary distractions.

item.title: RM566318: Microsoft 365 app: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot App (iOS)
item.description: Copilot Notebooks in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (iOS) now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time.

item.title: RM567300: Microsoft Teams: Prevent presence transition to "Do not disturb" setting when screen sharing (GCC High, DoD)
item.description: We're introducing a setting that allows users to opt-out of transitioning presence automatically to Do Not Disturb when presenting or screen sharing. This ensures that they can continue to receive calls, keeping them connected and responsive without manual presence adjustments.

item.title: RM567311: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Collection and DLP Policies for Intune-Policy Managed Apps
item.description: We are introducing a new integrated Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) capability for Intune Mobile Application Management (MAM)-protected mobile apps, enabling organizations to apply content‑aware protection policies to sensitive data on mobile devices. This integration ensures that clipboard actions in managed mobile apps are evaluated against Purview DLP policies before sharing is allowed, helping reduce data leakage, insider risk, and exposure to advanced threats across mobile work...

item.title: RM567886: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
item.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. You can easily customize the report to your needs by specifying the audience, tone, length, and sections you want.

item.title: RM567890: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: We are increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive from 100,000 up to 500,000 files per tenant per day. This helps organizations label and protect more of their data at rest, faster, closing labeling gaps across existing content. With sensitivity labels and protection settings applied to more files sooner, organizations can better prepare their data estate for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater confidence.

item.title: RM569019: Microsoft Teams: Identify custom apps that need updates for Teams private and shared channels
item.description: Admins will be able to view in Teams Admin Center a list of custom apps in their tenant that need to be updated to work in private and shared channels. This experience will help admins identify impacted apps, understand which apps require developer action, and coordinate updates so users can continue using custom apps across all supported channel types.

item.title: RM570664: Outlook: Right-click to customize the classic ribbon
item.description: You can now customize the classic ribbon in New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the Web by right-clicking the ribbon and choosing which commands and groups appear on the Home and View tabs. #newoutlookforwindows

item.title: RM570856: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Capture project expenses directly from Field Service Work Orders
item.description: Technicians can create, update, and submit project-related expenses directly from a Work Order in Field Service web and mobile when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled. Expenses remain connected to the related project and follow the standard Project Operations approval process, helping teams capture field costs with less context switching and better financial traceability.

item.title: RM571301: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports custom Case-like records evaluation
item.description: Quality evaluation now supports on-demand evaluations for case-like custom entities in public preview. Organizations can extend evaluation capabilities beyond the standard case entity to supported custom Dataverse entities that follow a case-like service workflow. This enables teams to evaluate additional business records using the quality evaluation framework, while giving admins flexibility to configure evaluation entry points for their custom scenarios.

item.title: RM571397: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
item.description: Microsoft Purview is upgrading inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business. The experience integrates with a Microsoft Entra Conditional Access grant control and simplifies configuration while removing current Purview policy restrictions. Admins can now use expanded conditions and condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, configurable alerts and notifications, and rule match activities are visible in activity explorer.

item.title: RM571681: Power Apps: Modern, refreshed look for the mail app
item.description: Extends the Fluent-based modern, refreshed look for model-driven apps to the mail app, providing consistent controls, spacing, colors, and visual treatment when users work in that app. This was previously enabled for the monthly channel with the 2602.1 release and is now being enabled for the semiannual channel with the 2609.3 release.

item.title: RM573278: Power Automate: Schedule desktop flows directly with Scheduled Triggers
item.description: Scheduled triggers enable makers to run desktop flows on a recurring schedule directly from the Power Automate automation center, eliminating the need to create and manage intermediary scheduled cloud flows. Users can configure daily, weekly, monthly, hourly, or custom recurrence patterns, select the execution machine or machine group, and monitor upcoming scheduled runs from a centralized experience. Scheduled Triggers simplify desktop automation management and provide a more intuitive scheduli...

item.title: RM573292: Power Automate: Build and visualize desktop flows using Flowchart mode
item.description: Flowchart mode introduces a new visual authoring experience in Power Automate for desktop that allows makers to create, view, and edit desktop flows using a flowchart representation. Actions are displayed as connected nodes and execution paths are represented visually, making it easier to understand, build, and maintain complex automations that include conditions, loops, and branching logic. Makers can create new flows directly in Flowchart mode or switch existing flows between Sequence mode and...

item.title: RM573447: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.

item.title: RM573701: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
item.description: Access to Archive mailboxes (Main + Auxiliary) through Microsoft Graph. The goal is to give users a single, seamless Archive view, even though Archive data may physically reside across multiple auxiliary mailboxes with EWS Graph APIs being deprecated.

item.title: RM573702: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Increase in expansion limit for auto-expanding archive beyond 1.5 TB
item.description: Previously, auto-expanding archive mailbox expansion was supported only up to 1.5 TB, after which mailboxes would become inoperative. Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and enabling scalable archive growth as storage thresholds are reached. This capability to expand archives beyond 1.5 TB will be available to customers with eligible E5 licenses.

item.title: MC1489942: Microsoft Viva Insights: New Power BI report publishing capabilities for leaders
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding Power BI report publishing to leaders, allowing them to publish and distribute reports directly. The "Analyst report publish" setting is renamed "Report publish," managed by admins and on by default. Rollout begins November 2026, with no action required but governance review recommended.

item.title: MC1489931: Microsoft 365 Backup: Activity Logs
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup will introduce activity logs by mid-October 2026, enabling administrators to monitor backup and restore activities across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online. Logs include detailed metadata, filtering, search, export options, and role-based access within the Microsoft 365 admin center. No action required.

item.title: MC1489928: Microsoft Brand Kit: Duplicate an existing Brand Kit
item.description: Microsoft now allows Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners to duplicate existing Brand Kits to create new ones, simplifying setup for different brands or regions. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, aiming to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency in Brand Kit management.

item.title: MC1489926: Microsoft Create: Improved sharing controls for Brand Kits
item.description: Microsoft Create now allows Brand Kit owners to modify sharing permissions after sharing, including changing user access between view and edit or removing access. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations better manage Brand Kit access as collaboration needs evolve.

item.title: MC1486284: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Administrative Units support for DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot
item.description: Microsoft Purview extends Microsoft Entra Administrative Units support to Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Chat. Starting late 2026, admins scoped to AUs can manage Copilot DLP policies within their units, maintaining existing role-based access controls and tenant-wide policy enforcement. No action required.

item.title: MC1477185: Microsoft OneDrive: New pay-as-you-go storage billing option
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing option for additional OneDrive storage, allowing admins to let selected accounts exceed licensed quotas with automatic usage-based billing. Public preview is available now for commercial tenants, with general availability starting November 2026. No action is needed if unused.

item.title: MC1489691: Updates available for Microsoft 365 Apps for Current Channel
item.description: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting October 6th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this late...

item.title: MC1480873: Connected Platforms - Agent 365 extends observability to third-party agents
item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 will support observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude, enabling unified monitoring of runs, sessions, and exceptions. Rollout begins late October 2026 with admin controls for enabling data collection and platform-specific setup requirements.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable Attach file and drag-and-drop for external chats by default starting late October 2026, improving file sharing. Files are stored in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment, subject to existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Admins can disable this via Teams PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1489590: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Assign task level calendar for precise planning
item.description: We are announcing the ability to assign task level calendar for precise planning in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature provides an experience to change the task calendar on the Customizable task details pane . To enable this feature, from project parameters select Enable Customize Task Pane . When enabled through feature control, this functionality lets you: Set a task-level calendar on the Cu...

item.title: MC1472022: [Outlook Mac] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping organizations prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. Existing DLP policies will automatically apply, requiring no admin action, enhancing consistent compliance across email and calendar.

item.title: MC1472023: [Outlook Mobile] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. No admin action is needed; existing DLP policies will automatically apply, enhancing compliance across email and calendar.

item.title: MC1472019: [Outlook Mac] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. This enhances data protection by controlling wait times for policy checks, improving compliance and user experience. Administrators should review and configure policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1472021: [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. Administrators can configure wait times to enhance policy compliance and balance security with user productivity. Review and enable as needed.

item.title: MC1465779: Outlook for Mac: Sensitivity label recommendations and auto-labeling from attachments
item.description: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels for emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. Rollout begins mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but organizations should review label policies and inform relevant teams.

item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446805: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically filtered from dashboard data. The feature rolls out from mid-August to mid-November 2026, enabled by default for eligible organizations.

item.title: MC1438561: Microsoft Purview Data loss prevention: debug tools activity now visible in managed app rules
item.description: Microsoft decided not to proceed with making debug tools activity visible in managed app DLP rules for Microsoft Edge for Business. The protection blocking developer tools remains enforced by default, with no changes to enforcement or user experience. No action is required from administrators.

item.title: MC1484013: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app for users with multi-line calling, organizing call activity by phone line. The rollout begins early November 2026, with no action required. This update affects desktop and web Teams and simplifies managing multiple phone lines.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. No admin action is needed, but users should have supported browsers and support staff should be informed.

item.title: MC1485411: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. Available worldwide by late October 2026, it supports natural language interaction for report customization. No action is required; notify users and update training materials as needed.

item.title: MC1486295: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. item.description: Teams meetings automatically create a corresponding Planner plan to capture meeting tasks. item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support breakout rooms, allowing meeting organizers to assign and move these devices between breakout and main rooms. This feature, improving coordination and feature parity with Windows, will roll out worldwide from mid to late November 2026. No action is required.

item.description: Starting November 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer features while remaining private. item.description: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation, enhancing productivity. The update rolls out worldwide from early to late November 2026, requires no user action, and preserves existing tasks and settings.

item.description: Microsoft Word for Android will gain Copilot Agent Mode by late September 2026, enabling users to draft, reason, and refine content with AI assistance. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update guidance and review policies to align with this new task-oriented Copilot experience.

item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding desktop-style emoji shortcuts to iOS and Android, allowing users to insert emojis by typing keywords between colons (e.g., :smile:). The rollout begins mid-August 2026, enhancing mobile emoji input with no admin controls and requiring no user action.

item.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include the ability to create recurring optimizations on a schedule. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. The agent automatically runs optimizations and applies the results on the configured schedule.

item.description: Extends the modern, refreshed look to embedded app experiences so model-driven app content retains consistent Fluent styling and interaction patterns when it appears inside another host. item.description: Keep collaboration moving without disrupting the main discussion. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front with a clear reason, so makers never waste time configuring something that was never going to work.

item.title: RM569421: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds

item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a priority cleanup workflow enabling admins to hard delete specific OneDrive and SharePoint content, even under retention or holds, with required eDiscovery approval. item.description: A new capability called Auto-Archiving for Exchange Online will enter public preview in November 2025 (currently under private preview for selected customers). When a user's mailbox utilization exceeds 95% of its quota and archive mailbox is present, this feature automatically moves the oldest items excluding those tagged with “Never Move to Archive” from the primary mailbox to the archive mailbox to prevent mail flow disruptions by keeping usage below the safe threshold of 95% of mailbox quota.

item.title: RM557165: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: When a Teams Rooms on Windows acts as an organizer, co-organizer or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. item.title: RM557347: Outlook: Follow meetings in Outlook mobile

item.title: RM559794: Outlook: Keep Invitations After Responding in Outlook Mobile

You can choose which days are included in your work week by syncing from your default account or by customizing the days just for your device.

item.title: MC1449180: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling support for non-Microsoft applications

item.description: Outlook attachments now use a separate application configuration enforcing existing Conditional Access policies for download, preview, and upload. item.title: MC1478958: Microsoft SharePoint Online: Select page canvas elements for Copilot-assisted editing

item.title: MC1387681: Microsoft Purview | Insider Risk Management: Policy recommendation panel in IRM

item.description: Microsoft Teams' Copilot experience will be updated in October 2026 with a simplified, chat-centered design featuring improved navigation, chat layout, agent interaction, and Work IQ controls. item.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be updated in October 2026 to a simplified, chat-centered design with improved navigation, chat layout, and Work IQ controls. item.description: Microsoft Viva will add a feature allowing eligible users with at least 50 Copilot licenses to export de-identified Copilot agent usage data from the Agent Dashboard for analysis. item.description: Microsoft will retire the SharePoint Page Agent (Frontier) for SharePoint Online starting mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November 2026. item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings

item.title: MC1480870: New SharePoint Mobile Experience on iOS and Android
item.description: The SharePoint mobile app for iOS and Android is redesigned around a personalized Discover experience, launching mid-October 2026 worldwide. item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. item.title: RM501451: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in SharePoint

item.title: RM516577: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
item.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

item.title: RM554934: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

item.title: RM564969: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Teams Rooms on Windows users can now benefit from next generation IntelliFrame features on certified AI-capable cameras with on-device video processing. These capabilities are available with Teams Rooms Pro.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM570436: PowerPoint: Async Notifications for Copilot in PowerPoint
item.description: Enable users to leave PowerPoint, switch devices, go offline, or end their workday while remaining confident that Copilot will notify them when work is complete or requires attention.

item.title: RM570858: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Support multiple warehouse assignments for field technicians
item.description: Field technicians often source parts from more than one warehouse. Limiting a technician to a single warehouse can make it harder to reflect how materials are actually sourced across field operations.

item.description: Field work does not always have a single payer. item.title: RM570967: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Maker Guidelines
item.description: The Maker guidelines feature gives organizations a direct way to share guidance with Copilot Studio makers in the flow of work. No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1479513: Outlook: Insert Symbols
item.description: Outlook will allow users to insert symbols into emails via the Insert tab, rolling out worldwide from October to December 2026. No admin action is needed, but users should be informed, and training materials updated. This affects new Outlook for Windows, Outlook on the web, and Exchange Online.

item.title: MC1479506: Video recap in Microsoft Teams supports more languages
item.description: Microsoft Teams Video recap, which uses AI to create narrated highlight videos from meetings, now supports 23 languages and 31 locale variants. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot license users, it requires meetings to be 10–90 minutes, recorded, and transcribed. Rollout begins late September 2026.

item.title: MC1479503: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Permission changes for select App Governance Entra roles
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps is updating App Governance permissions for select Microsoft Entra roles to align with Defender XDR Unified RBAC. Changes affect Cloud App Security, Compliance Administrator, and Compliance Data Administrator roles starting mid-October 2026. Admins should review and adjust role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1478970: Microsoft Purview | DLP-Create Purview network data security policies without pay-as-you-go configuration
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security policies can now be created without pay-as-you-go configuration, using Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access with appropriate licensing. Non-Microsoft integrations still require pay-as-you-go. Rollout begins late September 2026, enabling policy creation to protect sensitive data in network traffic automatically.

item.title: MC1187682: Microsoft Edge: Microsoft 365 Copilot will support summarization and contextual grounding
item.description: Microsoft Edge for Business now supports Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat for summarizing and contextualizing multiple browser tabs, YouTube videos (available), and Microsoft 365 documents (rolling out mid-October 2026). The feature is off by default, respects DLP and policy settings, and requires Entra ID sign-in and proper licensing.

item.title: MC1461157: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android will support attendee proximity join for Teams events, enabling users to quickly connect to nearby room systems. Rollout starts November 2026, completing by December. No action is needed; the feature will be enabled automatically to simplify joining meetings.

item.title: MC1478463: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Teams user reporting enabled by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enable Teams user reporting by default starting late October 2026 for licensed organizations. Users can report suspicious Teams content to improve threat detection. Admins can review or opt out via a dedicated Defender portal page before October 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1442614: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced IntelliFrame with AI data channel for intelligent cameras
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will gain enhanced IntelliFrame AI features via certified intelligent cameras, enabling faster speaker framing, participant recognition, and smoother views, especially in low bandwidth. item.title: MC1479296: Dynamics 365 Sales -Streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach
item.description: We are announcing the ability to streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach in Dynamics 365 Sales. item.title: MC1269864: Microsoft Teams: New chat sections for muted and meeting chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce two new chat sections—Muted chats (enabled by default) and Meeting chats (disabled by default)—to organize conversations. Rollout starts mid-October 2026, completing by mid-November. Users can enable, disable, and reorder these sections; no admin action is required.

item.title: RM503553: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search
item.description: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search. In the Microsoft 365 admin center, under Copilot > Search > Authoritative content, add and manage up to 100 SharePoint sites. #copilotcontrolsystem

item.title: RM503772: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Copilot Extensibility] Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents
item.description: Users in DoD will be able to use custom engine agents.

item.title: RM557563: OneDrive: Improved max path error experience on desktop
item.description: OneDrive desktop sync users now get clearer, more actionable guidance when file paths exceed the supported 520-character limit. The updated experience shows exactly how many characters a path is over the limit and offers a guided flow to rename or move the affected items so they can sync.

item.title: RM558437: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention– Unmanaged cloud app discovery and protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview network data security now integrates with Island, extending protection to Island’s browser-based workflows at the point of user interaction. item.title: RM558933: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting archive for knowledge retention
item.description: Admins can enable a tenant-wide policy that allows Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after transcripts expire. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting archive is stored.

item.title: RM559017: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Work IQ APIs: Pay‑As‑You‑Go usage
item.description: Enables metered, pay‑as‑you‑go access to Work IQ endpoints, allowing developers to invoke agents and capabilities without requiring pre‑assigned licenses, with usage billed based on the agents and models invoked per request.

item.title: RM560076: SharePoint: Create charts on pages with AI
item.description: This feature empowers authors to create rich, interactive charts with AI in SharePoint when editing SharePoint pages. Authors can describe the chart they want to create in plain language within a chat on a SharePoint page.

item.title: RM560822: SharePoint: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Recipient groups in eSignature allow a recipient slot to be assigned to multiple people, such that any one of those people can fulfil the signing requirement on behalf of the group.

item.title: RM562017: Microsoft Viva: Fresh Copilot Metrics in Custom Person Queries & Reports- Viva Advanced Analysis
item.description: Key Microsoft 365 Copilot metrics in custom person queries and reports will have values up to 2-3 days old from the current date. This will provide fresher copilot usage analysis to analysts in Viva Advanced analysis.

item.title: RM562343: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
item.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

item.title: RM565222: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
item.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

item.title: RM566527: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Ensure regulatory compliance by deleting inactive OneDrives and mailboxes for departing employees
item.description: Enables admins to delete both content and containers for departed users at scale thereby keeping your tenant compliant without any manual effort.

item.title: RM568782: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM570446: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

item.title: RM570846: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
item.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

item.title: RM571191: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Detailed quality evaluation score breakdown
item.description: Evaluation details now include a scoring breakdown at the overall, section, and question level. Users can see how the final evaluation score was calculated, including how individual question outcomes contribute to section scores and the overall score. This improves transparency, helps quality teams validate results, and makes it easier to identify areas for coaching, calibration, and process improvement.

item.title: RM571192: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Support Not Applicable answer option for quality evaluation criteria
item.description: Criteria questions now support a Not Applicable answer option. When a question is marked as not applicable, it is excluded from scoring instead of negatively affecting the evaluation score. This helps ensure evaluations remain accurate when a specific criterion does not apply to the case, interaction, or business scenario being reviewed.

item.title: RM571193: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Inactivate quality evaluation records
item.description: Quality managers can now inactivate evaluation records that should no longer contribute to scoring or reporting. Inactive evaluations are preserved for traceability but excluded from overall score calculations and analytics. This helps teams correct reporting outcomes when evaluations were created in error, used the wrong criteria, were duplicates, or should otherwise be removed from active quality results.

item.title: RM571302: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Quality evaluation supports knowledge source in criteria
item.description: Criteria questions can now use knowledge sources to help evaluate customer interactions. This allows organizations to ground evaluation criteria in approved knowledge content, policies, or guidance so quality checks can better reflect expected handling standards. This preview capability is scoped to case and on-demand evaluations.

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter or any participant’s video into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

item.title: RM571390: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: MC1476322: Customized PowerBI reports behavior after major report updates
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights customized Power BI reports will remain tied to their original report versions and won’t auto-update with major report changes. Users must create new customized reports from the latest versions to access updated data and features. No admin action or policy changes are needed.

item.title: MC1476319: Microsoft SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
item.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will shift AI-assisted FAQ creation to Copilot in SharePoint, while retaining manual FAQ editing in the web part. Rollout starts late October 2026. Existing content remains unchanged, requiring no migration. No admin action needed; inform authors and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1476237: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Remediation actions from the Teams message entity flyout
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will enhance the Teams message entity flyout by late September 2026, enabling security admins to submit messages to Microsoft and block senders or domains in one workflow. This streamlines Teams message investigations for Plan 1 and Plan 2 customers without requiring configuration changes.

item.title: MC1476008: Dynamics 365 Field Service – Automate optimizations with Scheduling Operations Agent (Preview)
item.description: We are announcing the ability to automatically schedule and run recurring optimizations through the Scheduling Operations Agent in Dynamics 365 Field Service. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables the following capabilities: Configure recurring optimization schedules: Create optimization plans that automatically run on a defined schedule, eliminating the need to manually start each optimization run. Customize optimization goal...

item.title: MC1421920: Surveys agent retirement and transition to Copilot in Microsoft Forms
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Surveys agent by August 31, 2026, transitioning users to a unified Copilot-powered experience within Microsoft Forms. Existing users lose access by December 2026. No licensing changes are needed; workflows continue seamlessly with enhanced AI features. Users should be informed and documentation updated accordingly.

item.title: MC1290821: eSignature for Microsoft 365 - Recipient groups
item.description: Microsoft 365 eSignature introduces recipient groups, allowing up to 10 people per recipient slot, with the first signer fulfilling the requirement. This reduces delays in signature workflows. Public preview ends late September 2026; general availability runs December 2026. No admin action needed; feature respects existing policies.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: AI meeting archive file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting archive files starting early November 2026 to improve Copilot and Facilitator responses while ensuring privacy. Archives are stored in tenant-owned SharePoint, accessible only to meeting participants, and governed by configurable retention policies. Admin controls will be available before rollout.

item.title: MC1462915: Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must ensure network and security controls allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft to avoid Copilot access disruptions across web, desktop, and Edge apps. Validate connectivity and update allow lists before October.

item.title: MC1475801: Dynamics 365 Contact Center – Enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests
item.description: We are announcing the ability to enable AI-assisted time-off and swap requests in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach general availability on October 1, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables an AI-assisted solution that provides automation for workforce schedules and approvals, governance across time‑off requests, shift bidding, and shift swapping. Supervisor oversight is supported throughout, along with configurable approval rules, and agent-driven decisions with...

item.title: MC1474455: In-app browsing in Copilot app
item.description: The Microsoft Copilot app now supports in-app browsing on Windows and Mac, allowing users to open websites side-by-side with chat. Administrators can opt-in selected devices to test this feature, manage policies, and prepare support. Browsing data is stored locally, and users can open links externally if desired.

item.title: MC1475456: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Perform bulk operations for bookings on schedule board
item.description: We are announcing the ability to move or reassign multiple bookings at once, directly from the schedule board in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach public preview on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature eliminates repetitive, manual edits required during common scenarios such as resource replacement, timeline shifts, scope changes, or schedule realignments. The feature significantly reduces administrative effort and helps you respond quickly to change a...

item.title: MC1474458: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Power BI reports as references in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: Copilot Notebooks now support adding Power BI reports as references, enhancing summaries with real business data. Public preview starts late September 2026; general availability begins late October 2026. No extra setup is needed if Power BI and Copilot are already enabled. Organizations without Power BI see no change.

item.title: MC1249424: Microsoft Purview DLP: Unmanaged cloud app protection with Microsoft Purview and the Island Enterprise Browser
item.description: Microsoft Purview now integrates with the Island Enterprise Browser to extend data loss prevention and network data security to browser-based workflows. Available from late March 2026 (preview) and June 2027 (general availability), admins must enable this feature to inspect and protect data shared via Island-managed browsers using existing Purview policies.

item.title: RM487852: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
item.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.
